$comment: Dogfood scope for applying the harness to its own repository. Only the checker or verification script may set done.

features.name: Autonomous loop runs natively on Windows
features.behavior: A scaffolded target runs its autonomous loop and named dispatch through one cross-platform Node control plane.
features.falsifier: The scaffold still requires Bash for loop orchestration or duplicates control logic in a PowerShell or cmd implementation.

context.note: HI-045; Node is already the required runtime and wrappers must contain no control logic.

features.name: Canonical harness demo remains green
features.behavior: The canonical demo scaffolds disposable targets, injects failures, and proves every advertised harness gate end to end.
features.falsifier: A template or verifier regression escapes because only static files were inspected instead of exercising a disposable target.

context.note: This is the repository's authoritative regression gate; do not replace it with root-level structural coverage.

features.name: Repository satisfies its own 13-lesson contract
features.behavior: The repository root exposes all thirteen structural harness lessons without weakening the canonical coverage checker.
features.falsifier: The skill claims a discipline that its own root lacks, such as no external state, readiness contract, or independent checker.

context.note: Root files are target-owned dogfood state; reusable fixes still belong under harness-loop/.

features.name: Generated runtime agents and verifier agree
features.behavior: Kiro, Claude, and Codex runtime entries are generated from one manifest and the target verifier reports no blocker.
features.falsifier: A hand-edited or stale runtime agent silently diverges from the manifest used by the other runtimes.

context.note: Regenerate with tools/gen-agents.mjs; never reconcile generated files by hand.

features.name: Mechanical promotion into memory/shared/ (v1)
features.behavior: node harness-loop/scripts/memory-promote.mjs --target DIR writes a memory/shared/facts.md entry when the same normalized checkerNotes-first-line or trace `detail` recurs across >=2 features/occurrences, and at least one source has evidence type test or tool-output. Never promotes from evidence:inference alone.
features.falsifier: memory-promote.mjs promotes from a single occurrence (violates [INV-PROMOTE-1]), promotes when every source is evidence:inference (violates [INV-SHARED-1]), or writes something other than a templated entry citing its sources.

context.note: v1 scope only (docs/design/shared-memory-tier.md INV-PROMOTE-1) — reuses memory-consolidate.mjs --bootstrap's exact recurrence detection, adds evidence-typed mechanical writing. Free-text matching is v2, not this feature.

features.checkerNotes:
Verification was replaced: the grep-on-step-header check did not discriminate.

Mutation-tested, it passed even with INV-SHARED-1's skip guard removed — it asserted a heading existed, not that the behavior held. Now it checks demo.sh's own exit code, and the same mutant makes it fail.

features.name: verify-harness gate for memory/shared/
features.behavior: verify-harness.mjs flags (warn, gate memory-shared) any memory/shared/*.md entry with evidence: inference or a missing evidence field, and flags a memory/shared/ index over the same 200-line budget MEMORY.md already uses.
features.falsifier: the memory-shared gate misses an inference-only entry (violates [INV-SHARED-1]), fires as a blocker instead of warn, or does not fire on an over-budget index.

context.note: docs/design/shared-memory-tier.md INV-SHARED-1; mirrors the existing gate memory (MEMORY.md budget check).

features.checkerNotes: Same class of rejection as feat-shared-memory-promote (shared verification pattern). Fixed and re-mutation-tested on the gate's own evidence check — now correctly fails when disabled.

features.name: Every agent reads memory/shared/ read-only
features.behavior: gen-agents.mjs computes memory/shared/*.md into every generated agent's resources at generation time (same pattern as subagentAllExceptSelf's roster), and no agent's writes/allowedPaths ever includes memory/shared/**.
features.falsifier: a generated agent config omits memory/shared/*.md from its resources (violates [INV-RES-1]), or memory/shared/** appears in any agent's writes/allowedPaths (violates [INV-SHARED-2]).

context.note: docs/design/shared-memory-tier.md INV-RES-1/INV-SHARED-2; guard-write.mjs already denies writes outside an agent's allowedPaths, so this feature only needs to keep memory/shared/** out of every agent's writes list.
